## Type of Change

- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or page
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation addition or update
- [ ] `style`: Visual styling, Tailwind tokens, or typography polish
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization or bundle size reduction
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependencies, or configuration update
